title: Choose how your character starts
content:
Character creation

  • Choose your stat rolling system. Default offers consistently strong starting stats and a quick start. Advanced offers a wider range and lets you reroll before accepting a set.
  • The same four bonuses. Both choices give four +5 selections, followed by optional stat swaps. A stat already at its maximum does not use up a selection.
  • Smoother creation on phones. Creation steps scroll on short screens, and the final review adapts its stats and navigation to narrow displays. A waiting message stays visible while the game processes your choice. Errors appear once and leave the controls available; restarting or cancelling clears the unfinished stat selection.

These choices apply to new characters. Existing characters keep their stats.
